SELECT 
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total_cat1_8,
  SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total_cat9,
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total_completo
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote' AND data LIKE '2026-07%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING(data, 9, 2) AS UNSIGNED) <= 15;
